merge.why: USER RULING 2026-10-16: 'I think K=18 for this deck in the bucketing. The colourless lands should merge and so should Evolving Wilds + Terramorphic Expanse.' Same card for this deck (sacrifice: a basic onto the battlefield tapped); play already folds them into one identity class, and the user's Titan rule treats them as one ('they are the same so just choose one that is in the deck').

USER RULING 2026-10-16: 'The colourless lands should merge' (same message as above; K=18 = 20 distinct names less these two merges). Both are colourless-mana lands that enter untapped and add no landfall beyond the land drop; the user's out-of-basics Titan order lists them together.
